cases.note: views: pionView(offer, publish, nil); a view is joined with CRLF and ends in CRLF. A view left out (empty, with same true) is the offer itself. chains: the steps of a chain share one memo, as one connection's offers do. codec_tables: the codecs registerSectionCodecs hands the WebRTC stack for each audio and video section of the text (of its view when viewed), in its order.
cases.text: An offer is: the text of the table named by base, or the text sdp; then with lf every CRLF made a bare LF; then each edit replacing the first old by new; then with tail one more line, a= and tail times the letter x and CRLF.
